symptom: ako/mxcli#721 L5 review: `database from $ctx/Assoc/Entity` under a pluggable widget's own datasource key (combobox optionsSourceAssociationDataSource) executed as 'Created page' and was stored as the entity alone (describe: `database from Rules.BusinessRule`) - a retrieve of every row instead of the context's. check and exec clean.
cause: The off-list-view refusal checked only the widget's `DataSource:` property, but the widget engine reaches buildDataSourceV3 from named datasource keys and object-list item properties too, and buildDataSourceV3 built the association path for any caller. Fix: buildDataSourceV3 refuses the form; only the new buildListViewDataSourceV3, called by buildListViewV3, builds it.
insight: A guard on one property name is not a guard on a builder with several callers. Put a form only one writer can store behind an entry point only that writer's builder calls, so new call sites are refused by default.
